title: First coordinate of the scope decomposition
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, let $r$ be a natural number, and let a constraint be given by a linear equation over the field with two elements, with a nonempty ordered tuple of distinct variables from $V$ as its scope. For any assignment $x:V\to\mathbb{F}_2$, the first component of its decomposition into values on the constraint scope and values outside that scope, evaluated at position $i$, is $x$ evaluated at the variable in scope position $i$.
hypotheses_covered: the constraint has an arity between $1$ and $r+1$
the constraint is a linear equation over $\mathbb{F}_2$
the scope is an ordered tuple of distinct variables in $V$
$i$ is a position in the constraint scope
